options.text: A Conditional Access policy using sign-in risk as a condition

Security defaults apply broadly and cannot condition on per-sign-in risk.
Legacy per-user MFA is always-on and not risk-conditioned.
Admin units scope management; they do not enforce authentication conditions.

items.stem: Which identity should an Azure VM use to access Key Vault without any stored credential?

options.rationale: Correct: a managed identity lets the resource authenticate to Azure services with no stored secret.

options.rationale: That stores a long-lived secret, which the requirement forbids.
